passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: You should carefully review the following discussion of the risks that may affect our business, results of operations and financial condition, as well as our consolidated financial statements and notes thereto and the other information appearing in this report, for important information regarding risks that affect us. Current global economic and geopolitical events and conditions as well as evolving regulatory scrutiny may amplify many of these risks. These risks are not the only risks that may affect us. Additional risks that we are not aware of or do not believe are material at the time of this filing may also become important factors that adversely affect our business. Business, Economic and Operating Risks We experience significant variation in our operating and financial results, including GMV and net revenues. All of our GMV, and substantially all of our net revenues each quarter come from transactions involving sales during that quarter. As a result, it is inherently difficult to accurately forecast our GMV, the amount and sources of our net revenues, earnings (loss) per share, operating income (loss), and our other key operating and financial performance metrics. Our operating and financial results have significantly varied on a quarterly basis throughout our operating history, and we expect our results to continue to fluctuate significantly for a variety of reasons, including all of the risks described in “Risk Factors,” including the following: • our success in attracting and retaining sellers and buyers; • changes in consumer confidence and discretionary spending trends, including shifts in interests away from any of our major focus categories; • the success of our marketing efforts; • the impact of competition on our business and industry; • our ability to convert visits into sales for our sellers; • our success in executing on our strategy and the impact of any changes in our strategy; • the timing and success of product launches, including new services and features we may introduce; • the amount and timing of expenses; and • changes in the geopolitical, legal and regulatory landscape, and our response to those developments. In view of the rapidly evolving nature of our business and the factors discussed above, period-to-period comparisons of our operating and financial results may not be meaningful, and you should not rely upon them as an indication of future performance. We face intense competition that may materially harm our business. The businesses and markets in which we operate are intensely competitive. We compete with a wide and growing variety of online and offline businesses that provide similar goods and services across numerous industries and geographies in which we operate, including traditional retail, e-commerce, live commerce, advertising, search engines, social media, and AI-powered tools (such as agents and chatbots). To succeed, we must compete effectively across the following factors: • ability to attract, retain and engage buyers and sellers from around the globe; 13 Table of Contents • brand recognition; • the price, breadth and relevance of our inventory; • the ease with which buyers can find the inventor

credit_strengths.text: Operating margin exceeds the sector median, reflecting eBay's asset-light marketplace model and high-margin advertising revenue. This profitability supports internal cash generation and provides a buffer against margin pressure from competition and promotional spending.

Interest coverage is comfortably above the sector median, with operating income covering interest expense multiple times. This headroom supports debt servicing capacity even if earnings decline, and the company's Altman Z-score places it in the safe zone.

key_risks.text: Operating cash flow declined notably from the prior year, and free cash flow after capital expenditures is modest relative to total debt. Shareholder distributions, including buybacks and dividends, absorb most free cash flow, leaving limited cushion for debt reduction or unexpected needs.

The company faces significant variation in operating results due to competition, consumer spending shifts, and macroeconomic factors. These risks could pressure revenue and cash flow, potentially weakening credit metrics if adverse conditions persist.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Debt maturities are well laddered, with a manageable portion due in the next twelve months and a substantial chunk due after year five. This profile reduces refinancing risk and provides flexibility to manage debt levels over time.

Net leverage is moderate and sits below the sector median, while cash balances provide a liquidity buffer. However, the current ratio is only marginally above one, indicating limited short-term liquidity headroom relative to current liabilities.

overall_credit_view.text: eBay's credit profile is supported by strong profitability, adequate interest coverage, and a manageable debt maturity profile. The company's asset-light model generates consistent operating cash flow, though recent declines warrant monitoring.

The indicative financial risk profile is intermediate, with leverage below sector median but cash flow coverage in a lower tier. Shareholder returns absorb most free cash flow, limiting deleveraging capacity. The credit outlook is stable, but execution risks and competitive pressures could pressure metrics.

credit_strengths.text: 營運利潤率高於行業中位數，反映eBay的輕資產市場模式及高利潤率的廣告收入。此盈利能力支持內部現金生成，並為應對競爭及推廣開支帶來的利潤率壓力提供緩衝。
利息覆蓋率舒適地高於行業中位數，營運收入覆蓋利息開支多倍。此緩衝支持即使盈利下降時的債務償付能力，而公司的Altman Z-score將其置於安全區域。

key_risks.text: 營運現金流較上年顯著下降，而扣除資本開支後的自由現金流相對於總債務而言適度。股東分派，包括回購及股息，吸收大部分自由現金流，為減債或意外需求留下有限緩衝。
公司因競爭、消費者支出轉變及宏觀經濟因素而面臨營運業績的重大變動。此等風險可能對收入及現金流構成壓力，若不利條件持續，可能削弱信用指標。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 債務到期日分佈良好，未來十二個月到期的部分可控，而相當大的一部分在五年後到期。此狀況降低再融資風險，並提供靈活性以隨時間管理債務水平。
淨槓桿適中且低於行業中位數，而現金結餘提供流動性緩衝。然而，流動比率僅略高於一，顯示相對於流動負債的短期流動性緩衝有限。

overall_credit_view.text: eBay的信用狀況受強勁盈利能力、足夠的利息覆蓋率及可控的債務到期狀況支持。公司的輕資產模式產生穩定的營運現金流，儘管近期下降值得監察。
指示性財務風險狀況為中等，槓桿低於行業中位數，但現金流覆蓋處於較低層級。股東回報吸收大部分自由現金流，限制去槓桿能力。信用展望穩定，但執行風險及競爭壓力可能對指標構成壓力。
